status: validated (機械検証合格 2026-11-05; パイロット承認済みの方針で作成)

segments.t: Soon afterwards,
segments.note: 「Soon afterwards,」は ἐν τῷ καθεξῆς。冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: he went about through cities and villages,
segments.note: 「he」は αὐτὸς

segments.t: preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom.
segments.note: 「bringing the good news」は εὐαγγελιζόμενος

segments.t: With him were the twelve,
segments.note: 「were」は英語の補い

segments.t: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities:
Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;
and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward;
Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.
When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him,
segments.note: 「When」は Συνιόντος。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない。「people」は τῶν … ἐπιπορευομένων

segments.t: he spoke by a parable:
“The farmer went out to sow his seed.
segments.note: 「farmer」は ὁ σπείρων（種を蒔く者）

segments.t: As he sowed, some fell along the road,
segments.note: 「As he sowed, some fell along the road」は καὶ ἐν τῷ σπείρειν αὐτὸν ὃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν

segments.t: and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
segments.note: 「under foot」は英語の補い

segments.t: Some seed fell on the rock,
segments.note: 「seed」は英語の補い（原文は ἕτερον のみ）

segments.t: and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
segments.note: 「as soon as it grew」は φυὲν

segments.t: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ ἕτερον ἔπεσεν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀκανθῶν καὶ συμφυεῖσαι αἱ ἄκανθαι ἀπέπνιξαν αὐτό

segments.t: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.”
segments.note: 「one hundred times as much fruit」は καρπὸν ἑκατονταπλασίονα

segments.t: As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”
segments.note: 「As he said these things」は ταῦτα λέγων

segments.t: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”
segments.note: 「Then」は δὲ。「does … mean」は εἴη の意訳

segments.t: He said,
segments.note: 「He」は ὁ

segments.t: “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom,
segments.note: 「it is given」は δέδοται

segments.t: but to the rest it is given in parables,
segments.note: 「it is given」（2度目）は前半 δέδοται の反復

segments.t: that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’
segments.note: 「that」は ἵνα。「may」は接続法

segments.t: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： Ἔστιν δὲ αὕτη ἡ παραβολή Ὁ σπόρος ἐστὶν ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ。「Now」は δὲ

segments.t: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
segments.note: 句全体の対応。「Those along the road」は οἱ παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν

segments.t: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy;
segments.note: 「Those on the rock are they who」は οἱ ἐπὶ τῆς πέτρας οἳ。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.
segments.note: 「but」は καὶ の対比的訳。「fall away」は ἀφίστανται

segments.t: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard,
segments.note: 「What fell among the thorns」は τὸ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας πεσόν。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: and as they go on their way
segments.note: 「and as they go on their way」は καὶ … πορευόμενοι

segments.t: they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life;
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ὑπὸ μεριμνῶν καὶ πλούτου καὶ ἡδονῶν τοῦ βίου συμπνίγονται

segments.t: and they bring no fruit to maturity.
segments.note: 「they bring no fruit to maturity」は οὐ τελεσφοροῦσιν

segments.t: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： τὸ δὲ ἐν τῇ καλῇ γῇ οὗτοί εἰσιν οἵτινες ἐν καρδίᾳ καλῇ καὶ ἀγαθῇ ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον κατέχουσιν καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἐν ὑπομονῇ。「honest」は καλῇ。「hold it tightly」は κατέχουσιν

segments.t: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed;
segments.note: 「when he has lit」は ἅψας。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.
segments.note: 「but puts it」は ἀλλ᾽ … τίθησιν

segments.t: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： οὐ γάρ ἐστιν κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ φανερὸν γενήσεται οὐδὲ ἀπόκρυφον ὃ οὐ μὴ γνωσθῇ καὶ εἰς φανερὸν ἔλθῃ

segments.t: Be careful therefore how you hear.
segments.note: 「Be careful therefore」は βλέπετε οὖν

segments.t: For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応： ὃς ἂν γὰρ ἔχῃ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ ἔχῃ καὶ ὃ δοκεῖ ἔχειν ἀρθήσεται ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ

segments.t: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： Παρεγένετο δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο συντυχεῖν αὐτῷ διὰ τὸν ὄχλον。「for the crowd」は διὰ τὸν ὄχλον

segments.t: Some people told him,
segments.note: 「Some people told him」は ἀπηγγέλη αὐτῷ（彼に告げられた）の意訳。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”
But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応： ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Μήτηρ μου καὶ ἀδελφοί μου οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ἀκούοντες καὶ ποιοῦντες

segments.t: Now on one of those days,
segments.note: 「Now」は Ἐγένετο δὲ

segments.t: he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： καὶ αὐτὸς ἐνέβη εἰς πλοῖον καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ

segments.t: and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.”
So they launched out.
segments.note: 「So」は καὶ

segments.t: But as they sailed, he fell asleep.
segments.note: 「But as they sailed, he fell asleep」は πλεόντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἀφύπνωσεν

segments.t: A wind storm came down on the lake,
and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.
segments.note: 「taking on dangerous amounts of water」は συνεπληροῦντο καὶ ἐκινδύνευον の意訳

segments.t: They came to him and awoke him, saying,
segments.note: 「They came to him and awoke him」は προσελθόντες διήγειραν αὐτὸν。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Master, Master, we are dying!”
segments.note: 「we are dying」は ἀπολλύμεθα

segments.t: He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water;
then they ceased, and it was calm.
segments.note: 「then」は καὶ

segments.t: He said to them, “Where is your faith?”
Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another,
segments.note: 「Being afraid, they marveled」は φοβηθέντες ἐθαύμασαν。δὲ（9番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”
segments.note: 「then」は ἄρα。「commands even」は καὶ … ἐπιτάσσει。ὅτι は引用の導入

segments.t: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes,
segments.note: 「Then」は Καὶ。「Gadarenes」は WEB が従う異読（Γαδαρηνῶν）の訳。ギリシャ語本文は Γερασηνῶν（ゲラサ人）

segments.t: which is opposite Galilee.
When Jesus stepped ashore,
segments.note: 「Jesus」は αὐτῷ の明示。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: a certain man out of the city who had demons
for a long time
met him.
segments.note: αὐτῷ は前半の「Jesus」に同乗

segments.t: He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.
When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said,
segments.note: 「When」は ἰδὼν。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “What do I have to do with you,
segments.note: 「What do I have to do with you」は Τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί の意訳

segments.t: Jesus, you Son of the Most High God?
I beg you, don’t torment me!”
For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man.
segments.note: 「Jesus」は文脈の主語で παρήγγελλεν に同乗

segments.t: For the unclean spirit had often seized the man.
segments.note: 「the unclean spirit」は文脈の主語の明示で συνηρπάκει に同乗。「often」は πολλοῖς χρόνοις

segments.t: He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters.
segments.note: 「was kept under guard and bound」は ἐδεσμεύετο … φυλασσόμενος

segments.t: Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.
Jesus asked him, “What is your name?”
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.
They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.
segments.note: 「They」は文脈の主語（悪霊たち）。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain,
segments.note: 「Now」は Ἦν δὲ

segments.t: and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those.
Then he allowed them.
segments.note: 「Then」は καὶ

segments.t: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs,
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
When those who fed them saw what had happened,
segments.note: 「When」は Ἰδόντες。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない。「them」は文脈の補い（豚）

segments.t: they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
segments.note: 「told it」は ἀπήγγειλαν。「country」は ἀγρούς（野・地方）

segments.t: People went out to see what had happened.
segments.note: 「People」は文脈の主語。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: They came to Jesus and
found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： καὶ εὗρον καθήμενον τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἀφ᾽ οὗ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐξῆλθεν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ

segments.t: clothed and in his right mind;
segments.note: 「his」は英語の補い

segments.t: and they were afraid.
Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.
segments.note: 「healed」は ἐσώθη（救われた）の文脈的意訳。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: for they were very much afraid.
segments.note: 「very much afraid」は φόβῳ μεγάλῳ συνείχοντο

segments.t: Then he entered into the boat and returned.
segments.note: 「Then」は δὲ

segments.t: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ἐδεῖτο δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀνὴρ ἀφ᾽ οὗ ἐξεληλύθει τὰ δαιμόνια

segments.t: that he might go with him,
segments.note: 「go」は英語の補い（原文は εἶναι σὺν αὐτῷ＝共にいること）

segments.t: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
segments.note: 「Jesus」は文脈の主語の明示

segments.t: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.”
segments.note: 「what great things」は ὅσα

segments.t: He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.
segments.note: 「went his way」は ἀπῆλθεν。「what great things」は ὅσα

segments.t: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： Ἐν δὲ τῷ ὑποστρέφειν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπεδέξατο αὐτὸν ὁ ὄχλος ἦσαν γὰρ πάντες προσδοκῶντες αὐτόν

segments.t: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue.
segments.note: 「Behold」は καὶ ἰδοὺ。「named Jairus」は ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰάϊρος。「was」は ὑπῆρχεν

segments.t: He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,
for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying.
segments.note: 「for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age」は ὅτι θυγάτηρ μονογενὴς ἦν αὐτῷ ὡς ἐτῶν δώδεκα

segments.t: But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.
segments.note: 「But as he went」は Ἐν δὲ τῷ ὑπάγειν αὐτὸν

segments.t: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ γυνὴ οὖσα ἐν ῥύσει αἵματος ἀπὸ ἐτῶν δώδεκα ἥτις ἰατροῖς προσαναλώσασα ὅλον τὸν βίον οὐκ ἴσχυσεν ἀπ᾽ οὐδενὸς θεραπευθῆναι

segments.t: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak.
segments.note: 「came behind him」は προσελθοῦσα ὄπισθεν

segments.t: Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.
Jesus said, “Who touched me?”
When all denied it, Peter
and those with him
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「and those with him」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you,
segments.note: 「said」は前半 εἶπεν

segments.t: and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「and you say, ‘Who touched me?’」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me,
segments.note: 「did touch」は Ἥψατο の強調的意訳。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”
When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling;
segments.note: 「When」は ἰδοῦσα。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: and falling down before him
declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ἀπήγγειλεν ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ δι᾽ ἣν αἰτίαν ἥψατο αὐτοῦ

segments.t: and how she was healed immediately.
He said to her, “Daughter,
cheer up.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「cheer up」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”
segments.note: 「has made you well」は σέσωκέν σε

segments.t: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came,
segments.note: 「While he still spoke」は Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος

segments.t: saying to him,
segments.note: 「to him」は英語の補い

segments.t: “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”
But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応： ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀκούσας ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Μὴ φοβοῦ μόνον πίστευσον καὶ σωθήσεται

segments.t: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in,
segments.note: 「When」は ἐλθὼν。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.
segments.note: 「her mother」は τὴν μητέρα（娘の母）

segments.t: All were weeping and mourning her,
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.
segments.note: 「They were ridiculing」は καὶ κατεγέλων

segments.t: But he
segments.note: 「But」は δὲ

segments.t: put them all outside,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「put them all outside」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”
Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately.
He commanded that something be given to her to eat.
segments.note: 「something」は δοθῆναι φαγεῖν（食べ物が与えられること）の内容の補い

segments.t: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ ἐξέστησαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτῆς ὁ δὲ παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς μηδενὶ εἰπεῖν τὸ γεγονός。「what had been done」は τὸ γεγονός
